sections.subhead: Accept Payments Securely, Across Any Platform, Without Losing Sales at Checkout

body.html: Payment Gateway Integration Company Kochi — that's what businesses search for when they need reliable, secure payment processing added to a website or store, regardless of which platform it's built on. Teknoppy sets up payment gateways correctly the first time, since a failed or clunky checkout is one of the fastest ways to lose a sale that was otherwise ready to close.

Choosing the right Payment Gateway Integration Company Kochi partner matters because payment failures rarely show up in testing — they surface with real customers, real cards, and real money, which is why correct setup and thorough testing matter more here than almost anywhere else on a website.

sections.h2: What Our Payment Gateway Integration Includes

items.title: Gateway Setup & Configuration
items.html: Payment gateway setup Kochi covers the full configuration — account linking, currency settings, and checkout flow — so payments process cleanly from day one, not after weeks of troubleshooting.

items.title: Popular Gateway Integrations
items.html: We handle Razorpay integration services Kochi for Indian businesses, Stripe payment integration Kochi for international-facing platforms, and PayPal integration services for buyers who prefer it — configured to match how your customers actually want to pay.

items.title: Secure & Compliant Setup
items.html: Secure payment gateway integration follows industry security practices from setup, and PCI compliant payment integration ensures cardholder data is handled the way payment processors require, protecting both you and your customers.

items.title: Multi-Currency & API-Level Integration
items.html: For businesses serving customers beyond Kerala, multi-currency payment integration handles international transactions cleanly. Where standard plugins don't fit, payment gateway API integration connects your platform directly to the processor.

items.title: Account & Gateway Setup

items.title: Checkout Flow Integration

sections.h2: Frequently Asked Questions — Payment Gateway Integration Company Kochi

items.q: Which payment gateways can you integrate?
items.a: We work with the major providers businesses in Kerala and the Gulf actually use — Razorpay, Stripe, and PayPal among them — along with other regional processors on request, matched to how your customers prefer to pay.

items.q: Is our payment data secure during checkout?
items.a: Yes. Secure payment gateway integration follows standard security practices, and PCI compliant payment integration ensures cardholder data is never handled or stored outside compliant, encrypted channels.

items.q: Can you set up payments in multiple currencies?
items.a: Yes — multi-currency payment integration is common for our clients serving both domestic and Gulf-based customers, with pricing and checkout displayed correctly per currency.

items.q: How long does payment gateway integration take?
items.a: A standard integration typically takes 1–2 weeks, though multi-currency or custom checkout requirements can extend this depending on complexity and how many gateways are involved.

items.q: Do you build custom payment flows if a standard plugin doesn't fit?
items.a: Yes. Custom payment gateway development covers cases where a business needs checkout logic — split payments, staged billing, or unusual currency handling — that off-the-shelf plugins don't support.

items.q: What happens if a payment integration breaks after launch?
items.a: We test thoroughly before launch specifically to avoid this, but ongoing support is available through our WordPress Maintenance Services or as part of your ecommerce platform's support plan.
